verdict.rationale: Ghostty documents a built-in AppleScript dictionary for scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts and input events, plus Apple Shortcuts (AppIntents) support. That is real first-party scriptability in a real language, but it is macOS-only external automation rather than an in-terminal plugin or extension system. libghostty is a developer building block for constructing terminals, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a cross-platform plugin/extension API, support for in-process scripting languages such as Lua or Python, a kitten-style extension mechanism, Linux scripting support, and independent hands-on corroboration of the AppleScript automation.
